about.title: About the Muslim Community in Slovakia
about.lead: The Muslim Community in Slovakia (KMS) was registered in the register of non-governmental non-profit organisations kept by the Ministry of Interior of the Slovak Republic on 1 December 2006 as a civic association.
about.founding_p1: After long discussions among Muslims from across Slovakia, a nationwide meeting was held at the end of 2006, at which the KMS statutes were approved and a registration application was submitted. Registration took place on 1 December 2006.
about.founding_p2: The community was founded with the main goal of developing the Muslim community in Slovakia.
about.goals_lead: The Muslim Community in Slovakia was founded with the main goal of developing the Muslim community in Slovakia. This includes, in particular, the following goals:
about.goal_1: Raising awareness among Muslims in Slovakia about the Islamic religion and cultural background
about.goal_3: Addressing the short-term and long-term difficulties Muslims face in everyday life
about.goal_4: Supporting the integration of Muslims in Slovakia into society
about.history_lead: The main stages of KMS's development can be summarised as follows:
about.history_1_body: After long discussions among Muslims from across Slovakia, a nationwide meeting was held at the end of 2006, at which the KMS statutes were approved. Registration took place on 1 December 2006.
about.history_2_body: After KMS was founded, its bodies were established. One of the first activities was creating a working group to collect signatures for registering Muslims as a religious society.
about.history_3_body: KMS members helped establish centres on Podkolibská St. and Peterská St. in Bratislava (both centres later closed). KMS maintained ties between Muslims in different parts of Slovakia.
about.history_4_body: From 2012 onwards, KMS activity gradually declined until it eventually stopped.
about.history_5_body: The needs of Muslims in Slovakia were not addressed systematically, which deepened some community problems. It became necessary to renew KMS activities – especially the social needs of the community.
about.aya_body: The Muslim Community in Slovakia is currently establishing cooperation with Nadácia AYA to use the premises of Centrum AYA, and with the Research Centre for Islamic Studies to complete the educational process for young people.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Answers to the most common questions about our community and the services we provide.
faq.q1: How can I get involved in the KMS community?
faq.a1: Simply contact us via the contact form or join our Friday gatherings and events at Centrum AYA.
faq.q2: What educational resources does KMS offer?
faq.a2: We are gradually preparing educational courses, clubs for children and youth, and community meetings focused on sharing experience.
faq.q3: Is the site and community suitable for new members too?
faq.a3: Yes, we welcome everyone who wants to learn more about the community or get actively involved.
faq.q4: Who manages the Muslim Community in Slovakia?
faq.a4: KMS is a civic association registered since 2006, run and managed by volunteers from among Muslims living in Slovakia.
faq.q5: Where and when do Friday prayers take place?
faq.a5: Friday prayers and sermons take place at Centrum AYA on Bojnická Street in Bratislava – the khutba in Slovak starts at 1:10 p.m., in Arabic at 2:00 p.m.
faq.q6: How can I get help or support from the community?
faq.a6: Contact us via the contact form on the Contact page – we are happy to help or point you in the right direction.
faq.help_desc: Write to us and we will be happy to help.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: This page explains what data we collect and how we handle it.
privacy.s1_p: Our website address is: https://kmssk.sk. We are the Muslim Community in Slovakia (KMS), a civic association registered by the Ministry of Interior of the Slovak Republic on 1 December 2006.
privacy.s2_p: When you fill in the contact form, we store your name, email address, phone number (if provided) and message content so we can respond to you.
privacy.s3_p: Our site only uses essential technical cookies (for example, to remember your chosen language and to keep you logged in to the administration area). We do not use third-party tracking or advertising cookies.
privacy.s4_h: How long we keep your data
privacy.s4_p: We keep contact form messages for as long as necessary to handle your request, but no longer than 24 months, unless the law provides otherwise.
privacy.s5_h: Who we share your data with
privacy.s5_p: We do not share your data with third parties for marketing purposes. Data may only be disclosed where required by law.
privacy.s6_p: Access to the site administration is protected by a password and a secure session. The database is accessible only to authorised community administrators.
privacy.s7_p: You have the right to request access to your personal data, its correction or deletion. Contact us at kms@kmssk.sk.
privacy.s8_p: The site may contain an embedded calendar or links to other websites (e.g. ayan.sk). Those sites have their own privacy policies.

footer.about_text: The Muslim Community in Slovakia (KMS) is a civic association registered since 2006 that supports and connects the Muslim community in Slovakia.
footer.follow_text: In cooperation with Nadácia AYA and Centrum AYA in Bratislava.
